title: MechWarrior 2: 31st Century Combat: Arcade Combat Edition
overview:
Rebuilt From the Ground Up

Introducing the all-new MechWarrior 2. Fully customized for the Sega Saturn, the Arcade Combat Edition features explosive 31st century combat with genuine shooter-style gameplay!

The year is 3057. A struggle for power fuels a society of warring clans. Bitter infighting perpetuates a universe of unrest. War is constant. Victory is temporary. Cease-fire is nonexistent. A pause in a stream of salvos is only a signal to re-calibrate crosshairs and redirect missiles. Time is scarce before the next unrelenting mission begins. For a MechWarrior, war is life. And death is the only true peace.

48 Arcade-Style Missions
Including 16 never-before-seen missions designed exclusively for the console system!

Ultra-Fast Gameplay
Simplified instant action controls and missions thrust you into high-intensity mayhem!

Turbo-Charged AI
Equipped with more 'Mechs per mission and intensified mission objectives for more enemy kills!

Awesome Power-Ups
Bonuses like Stealth, Invincibility and Fire-Rate Increase add to the furious 'Mech-to-'Mech combat!
